note: Vetted 3D models. Lessons may only reference these ids. Each file is downloaded once, checked against sha256 and served same-origin; the browser never fetches a third-party URL. Clips list only animations that mean something.

models.name: Saturn V rocket
models.description: Tall three-stage Apollo moon rocket, standing upright; rockets, thrust, staging, projectile and vertical motion.

models.name: International Space Station
models.description: Space station with long solar-panel trusses; orbits, circular motion, free fall, rotation.

models.name: Hubble Space Telescope
models.description: Cylindrical space telescope with solar panels; optics, orbits, pointing direction.

models.name: Apollo Lunar Module
models.description: Four-legged lunar lander; landing, descent under gravity, the Moon.

models.name: Mars rover (Opportunity)
models.description: Six-wheeled Mars rover; driving distance, velocity, terrain, exploration.

models.name: Space Shuttle orbiter
models.description: Winged spacecraft; flight, lift, re-entry, orbital velocity.

models.name: Asteroid Bennu
models.description: Irregular rocky asteroid; gravity, orbits, collisions, rotation, irregular shapes and volume.

models.name: CubeSat
models.description: Small cube-shaped satellite with fold-out panels; cubes, volume, rotation, satellites.

models.name: Fox
models.description: Animated low-poly fox that can look around, walk or run; motion, speed, distance-time, biology.

models.name: Delivery truck
models.description: Truck with spinning wheels; velocity, distance, rotation of wheels, rolling motion.
